user_request: Also validate whether a larger model helps
scope: Matched128-versus256-hidden-unit comparisons already present within each of the six registered families
fixed_comparison: same family and other architecture settings
same fitting donors and fold-specific representation
same allowed query donor and source/outcome support
same accepted-update prefix, seed and particle resolution
same objectives, normalization scales and stochastic source inputs
same declared abundance/spread calibration when directly paired

identity_semantics.configuration_specific: Keep distinct checkpoint, full objective-protocol and model-parameter inventories for V1 and V2; differing artifact hashes are expected
identity_semantics.common_objective: Match registry-verified scientific objective fields and the exact fitting-scale binding, excluding only the configuration-specific protocol identifier
identity_semantics.common_draws: Match actual verified sampler draw receipts with only the configuration label excluded; retain source/fold, seed, update, generation, law support, stream and particle bindings

report: all nine score-channel paired differences, never fitting loss alone
target, control and contrast errors separately
actual active parameter counts and measured inference cost
fit/update and scoring cost when measured
within-donor/representation effect sizes and capacity trade-offs
which matched longer-budget comparisons are available or unavailable
screening_budget: All128/256 pairs receive1024updates on all six fitting pairs before family pruning; this is a finite-budget capacity screen
later_comparisons: Use only pairs actually continued under the existing selectors at the same budget; no resuming an eliminated recipe solely to complete a capacity table
selection_boundary: Per-selector summaries use only that selector's permitted inner edges. No pooled all-donor capacity winner can alter an outer selector. Global retrospective summary follows all required forecast seals.
interpretation: Larger means more active parameters within the matched family; width is not proof of equal compute. Negative screening results do not establish that larger models cannot help at longer budgets or in other families.
beyond256_width: Requires a separately bounded prospective amendment; not silently added to the24-configuration search
